scripts.deploy:testnet: cd contracts && forge clean && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --account portir-deployer --password-file .keystore-password --broadcast --rpc-url bsc_testnet
scripts.deploy:mainnet: cd contracts && forge clean && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --account portir-deployer --password-file .keystore-password --broadcast --rpc-url bsc
